<thought>To determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups in the unknown sample, I will obtain its 13C NMR spectrum. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (~10–30 ppm). By counting distinct methyl carbon signals in the spectrum, I can infer the number of CH₃ groups. If no methyl signals are present, the answer will be 0.</thought>
